title: Part Twenty-Three: Urbit: the Digital Exit

sections.brief: The hierarchy (256 galaxies, 65,280 stars, ~4.29bn planets, Azimuth on Ethereum); Yarvin's own words: 'digital feudalism' (13 Jan 2010), Lords/Dukes/Earls and homesteading (Verge via Smith & Burrows), 'prince', 'Urbit is land', 'homestead principle', 'proof of stake', 'transparent plutocracy'; the 'single landlord' ideal; 2016 allocation (Tlon 95, urbit.org 50, staff 40 incl. Yarvin 24, investors 34, others 37); Tseng 2019 185/256; 2019 galaxies to urbit.org; Galactic Senate rules (quorum 64, majority 129); prices; users ('a few thousand', ~90 devs); not an anonymity tool; labelled interpretation (Smith & Burrows / Sophia) with counter-reading. Figures: flow, compare

Farewell promises (2019); Tlon/Foundation split (2021); August 2024 crisis (runway in months, Lehman dismissed, Colby interim, Blackman and Fitzgerald leave, token idea) and 'wartime CEO' in his words; Horowitz 2011 source of the phrase; Senate's duty to pick the board; 2025: a16z ($4M reported), private-club plan, Kneer-Yarvin board fight and no-confidence vote (newsletters with declared interests); 9 Oct 2025 Senate replaces board, new ED succeeds ~sorreg-namtyv who leaves to found a company; status Oct 2026; YELLOW stands; Book IV worst-case test (documented / probable / not supported), linking de22 ids, de8, de33, de40.
